settings.heading: 2x3 Area Rugs – Small Rugs with Big Stories
settings.row_content:
Some spaces don’t need a large rug.
They need the right rug.

A 2x3 area rug is perfect for those corners that quietly shape your home - beside the bed where your feet land first, near the door that welcomes guests, or in the bathroom where comfort matters most.

At Indian Rug Store, our 2x3 rugs are handmade in Jaipur by artisans who’ve been weaving rugs for generations. No factories. No shortcuts. Just skilled hands, honest materials, and designs made to live with you - every single day.

settings.heading: Why Choose a 2x3 Area Rug?
settings.row_content:
Small rugs do more work than we often realize.

They protect high-traffic spots.
They soften hard floors.
They add warmth without overwhelming the room.

A 2x3 carpet fits beautifully in:

  • Entryways & doorways
  • Bathrooms & powder rooms
  • Beside beds & cribs
  • Under small desks or accent chairs
  • Kitchen sinks or laundry areas

It’s functional decor - simple, thoughtful, and timeless.

A master weaver ties each knot slowly, carefully - just like his father taught him.

settings.heading: Purpose of a 2x3 area rug.
settings.row_content: For a small space such as an entryway, bathroom, or bedroom area, a 2x3 area rug will suffice. An area rug in this size will be ideal for a small desk as well as a kitchen area.

settings.heading: Will a 2x3 area rug be suitable in the bathroom?
settings.row_content: yes, it can, a 2x3 is great in the bathroom, and it would be best at the sinks or tub. You would want a cotton or machine washable one, as it helps to absorb and dry quickly.

settings.heading: In which room should a 2x3 rug be placed?
settings.row_content: For a 2x3 rug, the normal place to put it would be along the side of the bed, at the foot of the bed, or near a baby’s crib. This is because it will provide a soft surface for feet to land on without using up too much space.

settings.heading: Can 2x3 rugs be made by
settings.row_content: Handmade 2 by 3 rugs and especially hand-knitted wool carpets are very hardy. These can last for years even in areas where constant traffic is expected when made by artisans using natural materials.

settings.heading: What materials would be best suited for 2x3 area rugs?
settings.row_content: Wool is the best for durability and stain-resistance, while cotton is ideal for its lightness and wash ability, and jute for its natural textured finish.
